An '''''Interdictor Star Destroyer''''' took part in the [[Battle of the Sixela system]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Following the launch of [[resonance torpedo]]es toward the system's star, the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor'']] and the rest of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Behind the scenes==
This Star Destroyer appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]'', where it was identified only as an Interdictor Star Destroyer.

*''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]'' {{1st}}
